post.text:
Disturbing new images from the Epstein files have been released, showing when Jeffrey Epstein attempted to take his own life.

This attempt on his life occurred before he was officially pronounced dead by the government. https://t.co/cYVYuuWaPo
post.author_description: I am only on X and Telegram under the same handle. All other accounts are scamners and imposters.

description.description: Two frames showing Jeffrey Epstein in a blue Department of Justice anti-suicide smock. The first frame shows a head-and-shoulders view of Epstein against a light-colored wall. The second frame is a close-up of his torso and hands, showing his arms extended down with palms facing forward, and a mark visible around his neck area.
